summary.text: Software Engineer (IIIT Lucknow) with production experience at Zomato and Even Healthcare, building backend systems in Go, TypeScript, gRPC, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, and GCP/AWS. Codeforces Expert; recent work spans event-driven platforms, workflow engines, LLM pipelines, and latency.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Designed and built Action Cards, a server-driven engine (Go, Firestore, Cloud Tasks) turning consults, lab tests, scans, medicines, and claims into live home-screen cards and detail pages for ~70k members, cutting update lag from ~7.3s to ~2s.
Owned backend for Even Infinite's Hospital Pass: policy verification, tiered waitlist ranking, auto-approval, and renewals; pass engagement up 65%+.

Built a no-code care-journey engine that compiles member flows to GCP Workflows, with SQL-defined cohorts on a read-only Postgres mirror and a visual audience builder, letting care teams define outreach without engineers.
Built AI voice-call and call-audit pipelines (LLM transcription, summaries, auto-filled forms), auditing 19k+ calls and cutting manual follow-ups ~40%.
Cut consult-history API latency from 36s to 6.6s via per-policy-window caching; kept doctor-slot search under 3s through vendor outages.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Built an automated vehicle onboarding flow with plate detection across 15 screens, cutting manual review by 60% and onboarding errors by 80%.
Redesigned delayed-order ticketing workflows with automated escalation states and operator actions, reducing cancellation-prone cases by 80%.
Migrated logistics map tooling to Google Maps and optimized API usage patterns, reducing map-related operating costs by 25%.
Built a Python-based sync pipeline for ~1M support tickets, automating recurring operations workflows and eliminating 95% of manual sync effort.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
achievements: Built a production-safe Go SDK to stream multi-GB ZIP archives directly to S3, reducing transfer latency by 65% and cutting peak memory usage by 50%.
Developed a GPS ingestion service processing ~50k location events/sec with monitoring dashboards, improving ETA prediction accuracy by 12%.
Refactored service-to-service RPC flows using goroutines and gRPC batching, reducing P95 latency by 95% at ~2k TPS.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
achievements: Scaled a Strapi-based ERM platform to support ~1k RPS by adding in-memory caching, optimizing SQL queries, and restructuring backend routes.
Automated deployment and hosting setup using AWS, Docker, Nginx, Certbot, and reusable scripts, reducing manual infrastructure setup effort.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
achievements: Built backend and dashboards for a Next.js platform used by the UP Commercial Tax Department; automated tax-discrepancy reports cut manual work 60%.
